versions.changelog:
No user-facing changes introduced in version 1.0.1.

- No file modifications or updates detected.
- Documentation, functionality, and configuration remain the same as previous version.

Initial release of Avro Schema Manager.

- Validate Avro schema structure, including fields, types, defaults, logical types, and documentation.
- Check forward/backward schema compatibility and provide migration recommendations.
- Audit namespace conventions and cross-schema references.
- Review schema registry configuration, including compatibility settings and subject naming.
- Generate language-specific Avro code stubs.
- Plan schema evolution with best practices and risk warnings.
- Provide a final health and compliance report with actionable fixes.
